## Additional Resources

This page contains miscellaneous guidance, best practices, and resources that don't fit into other specific categories. From coding standards to project templates, find helpful information to streamline your workflow and maintain consistency across projects.

These resources are regularly updated based on team feedback and evolving best practices.

## Resources & Templates

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# Create sample miscellaneous resources data
resources_data <- data.frame(
  Resource_Name = c("R Coding Standards", "Python Style Guide", "Git Workflow Guide",
                    "Documentation Template", "Project Starter Kit", "Code Review Checklist",
                    "SQL Best Practices", "API Design Guidelines", "Security Guidelines",
                    "Data Privacy Policy", "Testing Framework Guide", "Deployment Checklist",
                    "Incident Response Plan", "Backup Procedures", "Performance Optimization Tips",
                    "Accessibility Guidelines", "License Compliance Guide", "Onboarding Guide"),
  Category = c("Standards", "Standards", "Process", "Template", "Template", "Process",
               "Standards", "Standards", "Security", "Policy", "Testing", "Process",
               "Operations", "Operations", "Performance", "Standards", "Legal", "HR"),
  Format = c("PDF", "PDF", "Wiki", "Quarto", "GitHub", "Markdown",
             "PDF", "Wiki", "PDF", "PDF", "Wiki", "Markdown",
             "PDF", "Wiki", "Wiki", "PDF", "PDF", "Quarto"),
  Last_Updated = c("2024-01-05", "2024-01-08", "2024-01-03", "2024-01-09", "2024-01-07",
                   "2024-01-06", "2024-01-04", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-10", "2023-12-15",
                   "2024-01-05", "2024-01-08", "2023-12-28", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-06",
                   "2024-01-03", "2023-12-20", "2024-01-09"),
  Downloads = c(234, 189, 456, 312, 278, 198, 167, 145, 289, 234,
                201, 223, 98, 156, 312, 178, 134, 267),
  Version = c("2.1", "3.0", "1.5", "1.2", "2.0", "1.8",
              "2.3", "1.4", "3.1", "2.0", "1.6", "1.9",
              "1.3", "2.2", "1.7", "1.4", "1.1", "2.5"),
  Mandatory = c("Yes", "Yes", "Yes", "No", "No", "Yes",
                "Yes", "No", "Yes", "Yes", "No", "Yes",
                "Yes", "Yes", "No", "Yes", "Yes", "No")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Last_Updated = as.Date(Last_Updated),
    Days_Old = as.numeric(Sys.Date() - Last_Updated),
    Freshness = case_when(
      Days_Old <= 7 ~ "Recent",
      Days_Old <= 30 ~ "Current",
      Days_Old <= 90 ~ "Review Needed",
      TRUE ~ "Outdated"
    ),
    Popularity_Score = round((Downloads / max(Downloads)) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, desc(Downloads))

# Create interactive table
datatable(resources_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 18,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf')
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Miscellaneous Resources Library") %>%
  formatStyle('Mandatory',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('Yes', 'No'),
                c('#fff3cd', '#f8f9fa')
              ),
              fontWeight = 'bold') %>%
  formatStyle('Freshness',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('Recent', 'Current', 'Review Needed', 'Outdated'),
                c('#d4edda', '#d1ecf1', '#fff3cd', '#f8d7da')
              )) %>%
  formatStyle('Popularity_Score',
              background = styleColorBar(c(0, 100), '#4b7874'),
              backgroundSize = '95% 75%',
              backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat',
              backgroundPosition = 'center') %>%
  formatDate('Last_Updated', 'toDateString')
```
